prompt: For project /home/me/app only, send review to a stricter Pi reviewer using gpt-5.6-sol, high reasoning, isolation, and read-only mode. Keep implement and consult inherited from the global quality profile.

assertions.text: Adds the new reviewer target to global ~/.openmcp/config.toml
Does not define a [[targets]] entry in project configuration
Project config uses [profiles.quality] and maps review directly to the new target ID
Leaves implement and consult unspecified so they inherit
